deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT: promotion v2.14.2 -> prod PAUSED. Reason: environment parity errors detected. Summary:
- config: `feature_flags.enable_heuristic` -> staging=true / prod=false
- secret: `secrets/prod/inference/relay` NOT FOUND (staging copy exists)
- model pin: release pinned to `quant-variant-v2` (no auto-fallback)
Full check: https://deploy.reports/1714567890/preflight

margo: Ugh. Secret gone and flags differ. We should avoid changing flags in prod without a rollout. Options: backfill secret from staging or temporarily unpin model for a limited canary. Thoughts?

raj: Do NOT flip the prod flag globally. Pin exists to prevent degradation. Backfill secret is safest.

lia: Canary unpin is doable but introduces complexity in router rules. Backfill + canary with the pin retained seems cleaner. I can run the canary plan.

jen-sre: Change window ends in ~90m. If we do a hotfix we need an ops window and runbook update. Tagging @clare-product for approval.

oliver: Why did the secret disappear? Any recent infra changes?

clare-product: I just checked the infra PRs. There was a rename in the secrets overlay last week that likely shifted `inference/relay` under `inference/relay-v2`. That explains missing path in prod. We should backfill and make the overlay change explicit in release notes. Do not flip prod flag.

margo: Plan: 1) Backfill prod secret from staging (sanitize values, KMS unwrap required). 2) Keep model pin. 3) Run canary (10% traffic) with feature_flag=true + pinned model. 4) If smoke OK, promote. Assigning tasks.

deploy-bot: Created tickets: #4452 (secret backfill prod), #4453 (canary smoke tests). Assignees: jen-sre, lia. Release state: PAUSED.

raj: Add a note to release docs explaining why quant-variant-v2 remains pinned and how to unpin safely later. Also include the overlay PR link that caused drift.

lia: Canary config ready. I'll spin up canary slice and run accuracy/latency checks. Expected run time 30m.

jen-sre: I will perform backfill now. Need KMS approval and audit header. ETA ~25m.

jen-sre: Backfill complete. KMS unwrap txn id: kms-0a1b2c3. Secret path created: `secrets/prod/inference/relay`. Audit tag: ticket-4452.

lia: Canary started (10% traffic). Initial metrics: 99.97% success, p95 latency within SLO, basic evals pass. Posting detailed runbook results in #ticket-4453.

margo: Good. Proceed to resume promotion. I'll update release notes: "prod config parity: secret backfilled; feature_flag remains default=false, canary run used flag=true for validation; model pin retained (quant-variant-v2)" and include links to tickets/PRs.

deploy-bot: Resume requested by margo. Promotion resumed for v2.14.2. Post-deploy hooks running.

deploy-bot: Promotion COMPLETE. Post checks: green. Release notes: https://releases.redwood/v2.14.2/notes (refs: #4452, #4453, infra-PR-312). :shipit:

clare-product: Thanks team. Follow-up: open infra PR to revert overlay rename or add alias to avoid future drift. Assign to infra team.

margo: Opening follow-up: infra-ticket-789 to add alias and a parity test. Will also add a preflight rule to flag renamed secret paths going forward.

deploy-bot: Closing thread - resolved.
